info.title: Unitfield Platform API
info.description:
Core module entry points
- Organizations: /api/v1/organizations
- Accounting: /api/v1/accounting
- Payments: /api/v1/payments

Create a resident maintenance or service request

Bearer.description: Enter a Unitfield API access token issued by Unitfield Auth. ID tokens are not API tokens.

OAuth2.description: OAuth2 authentication with Unitfield Auth. Request the unitfield-api audience.

OAuth2User.description: OAuth2 authorization-code authentication for interactive Unitfield users. App installation management operations also require 'X-Tenant-Id' and tenant permissions.
